messages.subject: StanCon 2017! Early registration ends 12/20.
parts:
Hi all,

The first ever Stan Conference is happening at Columbia University on January 21, 2017. mc-stan.org/events/stancon.html

Early registration for the conference ends on December 20, 2016, less than a week away! https://stancon2017.eventbrite.com/
If you register late, it's not only more expensive, but you might not get the one-off StanCon 2017 swag.

We're working through the submissions now and will have a schedule next week. There are 80 registrants so far and lots of great submissions!

A big thank you goes to our three sponsors: Columbia Data Science Institute, Metrum Research Group, and Stan Group Inc. 

We are still looking for additional sponsors. Please reach out to sta...@mc-stan.org or sponsor directly through this link https://stancon2017.eventbrite.com/?discount=sponsor#tickets
(With one more sponsor, StanCon will be running even. With two sponsors, we'll look at live streaming the whole event!)

Thanks and I hope to see you at StanCon. If you have any questions, please ask.



Daniel 
on behalf of the StanCon Organizing Committee
